7.1 新功能
• Cube CFOP 现已支持简体中文，以及越南语和德语。在“设置 > 语言”中选择，App 会立即切换。情况名称和记号保持魔友惯用的写法。

• OLL 识别、PLL 识别和双面 PLL 测验现在会把每种情况都问一遍，然后才重复。答错或跳过的情况会在几题之后再次出现。
• 复制公式：从任意公式的菜单中复制，方便粘贴到计时器或笔记中。
• 现在可以删除侧面视角的最后一条公式。前视角始终保留一条。
• OLL 2-Look 第一步的情况现在命名为 L-shape、Line 和 Dot，取代 1-1、1-2 和 1-3。
• 修复了部分用户 F2L 右后、左后和左前视角缺少推荐公式的问题。你在这些视角中写的公式仍排在最前。
• 修复了部分从版本 6 升级的用户中，PLL E 和 PLL Na 各有一条公式的起始角度与情况图示相差四分之一圈的问题。你自己写的公式保持不变。

如果你错过了 7.0.1
• OLL 和 PLL 情况新增四个视角：前、右、后、左。每个视角都从该侧绘制并以 3D 播放，并保存你为它编写的公式。在侧面视角中，“从前视角生成”会根据你的前视角公式写出该视角的公式。

如果你错过了 7.0
Cube CFOP 7.0 全面重做，带来学习和练习每种情况的新方式。

• 学习中：全新的标签页，提供四档评分闪卡（重来、困难、良好、简单）、每日复习，以及连续学习天数和学习日报告。
• 练习：OLL 识别和 PLL 识别、F2L 角块测验，以及计时练习。
• 公式：在 3D 魔方上观看任意公式，添加自己的别名和备注，并搜索所有情况。编辑器会检查公式能否还原该情况。
• 指南：从概览到 PLL 的 CFOP 方法、3D 魔方上的还原示例、Finger trick，以及重新绘制的记号指南。
• 另外：你的魔方配色和握法、浅色和深色外观、iPhone Duo 和 iPad 双栏布局、键盘快捷键，以及全新的 App 图标。
• 不收集使用数据。App 只发送崩溃报告。

你的收藏、编辑过的公式和闪卡进度都会保留。你的公式列表保持不变；如需使用新的推荐公式，请前往“设置 > 恢复默认公式”。

用闪卡学习

指南

• 还原示例：在 3D 魔方上观看一次完整还原，每一步和每种情况都有标注。
• 记号：每个转动都在魔方上演示。
• Finger trick：快速转动背后的 trigger 和握法。

适合你的转法
• 你的魔方配色和握持方式。
• 浅色、深色或跟随系统外观。
• 英语、越南语、简体中文或德语，可在 App 内直接切换。

一次购买。无广告、无订阅、无需账户，也不收集使用数据。

hk.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

mo.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

tw.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

iPhone Duo is the special case. Fold your Duo into tabletop mode and the phone itself transforms into the computer: the screen stands up above and a working keyboard lies flat below, so you hold and type on the machine itself. Close your Duo to browse the collection and choose your next exhibit.

All ten computers are included. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is the first standalone chapter to the cooperative point-and-click puzzle game series 'Cryptic Killer'. Join forces with a friend and play as detective partners Ally and Old Dog in our debut two-player escape room adventure.



IMPORTANT: "Unboxing the Cryptic Killer" is a 2-player cooperative puzzle game, that requires each player to have their own copy on either mobile, tablet, PC or Mac. Internet connection and voice communication are essential. Need a Player Two? Join our Discord community!



Two seasoned detectives, Ally and Old Dog, are entangled in a chilling unsolved case. Lured on a perilous trail, they fall into the clutches of the enigmatic Cryptic Killer they've been relentlessly pursuing. The stakes are sky-high as two innocent lives hang in the balance. In order to save them, Ally and Old Dog must unravel a box of intricate puzzles masterfully designed by the nefarious killer. Test your mettle and join this high-stakes race against time, where every puzzle solved is a step closer to unmasking the Cryptic Killer.



THE ONLY WAY TO ESCAPE IS TO WORK TOGETHER
Unboxing the Cryptic Killer is a puzzle for exactly two players. The name of the game is collaboration. Each player takes on one of the two roles and works their way through a series of challenging puzzles. You'll each see one half of the same puzzle and must work together to crack the codes and escape the Cryptic Killer's clutches.



FEATURES LIST
▶Two Player Co-Op 
In Unboxing the Cryptic Killer, the detectives are separated. You’ll see different items and clues than your partner, and will be tested on your communication!
▶Challenging Collaborative Puzzles
Two brains are better than one when it comes to cracking the Cryptic Killer's codes.
▶Unravel a Thrilling Story
Track the Cryptic Killer's movements as Detectives Old Dog and Ally in this ongoing murder mystery saga.
▶Explore Illustrated Worlds
Unboxing the Cryptic Killer features hand-illustrated environments that are inspired by noir novels.

You cannot solve a case without taking notes. At any time in the game, you can whip out a notebook and pen to make notes and scribble on your environment.

tr.description:
Build the dungeon. Set the traps. Wait for the heroes.

Skel & Defense is a dungeon defense roguelike where you play the villain. Expand your dungeon room by room, fill it with deadly traps, transform into Skel, and stop wave after wave of heroes coming for your treasure.

Combine the strategy of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike, and build a dungeon no adventuring party can survive.

◆ Become the Dungeon Master, Not the Hero

Every dungeon has a monster waiting in the darkness. This time, that monster is you.

At night, expand your dungeon and prepare your traps. During the day, defend the gates against waves of invading heroes.

Build, defend, improve, and repeat. Turn a humble underground tomb into an unstoppable fortress.

◆ 26 Trap Rooms, Countless Combinations

Build and combine 26 unique trap rooms, including fireballs, lava zones, freezing mist, icicles, saw blades, poison arrows, electromagnetic fields, and more.

Combine rooms of the same element to unlock powerful synergies.

Freeze enemies before burning them alive. Trap them in narrow corridors and finish them with poison. Your dungeon layout determines how long the heroes survive.

◆ Transform into Skel and Fight

Traps are not your only weapon.

Transform into different Skels and fight the invaders yourself.

Become a Mage Skel and launch fireballs from the rear, a Rogue Skel throwing shurikens, or a Shield Skel holding the front line.

When your traps are not enough, finish the job yourself.

◆ 7 Stages, Endless Mode, Global Rankings

Conquer 7 stages with different rewards, then enter Endless Mode and face increasingly powerful waves.

How long can your dungeon survive?

Register a nickname in the options menu to join the global rankings and compete with players around the world.

◆ Over 30 Perks, A Different Run Every Time

Choose from more than 30 perks during each stage.

Take powerful upgrades to strengthen your build, or accept dangerous penalties in exchange for bonus score.

Focus entirely on traps, strengthen your Skel, or combine both approaches. Every run is different, and every decision matters.

◆ Grow Stronger with Every Run

Defeat waves to earn Trait Points and unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs stronger.

Explore the Collection to uncover hidden synergies, new rooms, and powerful relics.

There is always one more strategy to discover.

◆ Full Controller Support

Prefer playing with a controller?

Build rooms, choose perks, use the shop, warp through the dungeon, browse the Collection, and control every major screen with a gamepad.

On-screen button prompts are supported, and you can freely switch between controller and touch controls.

◆ A Premium Dungeon Defense Built for Replayability

Short runs. Deep strategy. And that feeling of wanting to survive just one more wave.

• Dungeon defense combined with roguelike progression
• 26 trap rooms with elemental synergies
• Multiple Skel forms for direct combat
• 7 stages plus an increasingly difficult Endless Mode
• Global ranking competition
• More than 30 perks that change every run
• Permanent upgrades, relics, and hidden synergies
• Full gamepad support
• Cloud save support
• Playable in 13 languages

If you enjoy tower defense games, roguelikes and roguelites, dungeon management, base defense, strategy games, or survivor-style action, Skel & Defense was built for you.

The heroes are already coming.

Build your dungeon, prepare your traps, and show them who the real master of the dungeon is.

pt.description:
Ten miniature machines from decades of computing sit on the table in front of you, each with a working screen and a keyboard you can type on. Spend a little time with an old favourite, or discover the computer your parents grew up with.

Some computers stay with you long after you stop using them. Now there's room for them on your desk again.

EXPLORE THE COLLECTION

Ten computers are ready to play with, inspired by the Macintosh, Commodore 64, IBM PC, Amiga 500, Windows 95, ThinkPad, iMac G3, iBook G3, PowerBook G4 and Windows XP.

TYPE, DRAW AND PLAY

Enjoy clicking keyboards, working command lines, paint programs, floppy disks and familiar desktop games. Open windows, write a note, draw something small and explore each computer's personality. Type 10 PRINT on the Commodore, run BASICA ROOFTOP at the DOS prompt, or load BRICKS from the Amiga's floppy. Occasionally, even Windows crashes.

FIFTY NOSTALGIC SECRETS

Every computer hides five nostalgic secrets: pieces of real computing history, a hidden game and, where its era had them, screen savers. Turn on the Hot Dog Stand colour scheme, ask the 1541 for its directory, meet Rover, or fill a 1984 Mac's memory until the bomb appears. Each computer's page in the collection keeps track of what you've found. Stuck? Open a hint, one at a time: what it is, where to look, then exactly what to do.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD

Each computer appears on your screen as a real little machine resting on an oak table, with its own case, keys and controls. On iPad, the whole computer is in front of you. On iPhone, turn sideways to see the whole machine, then zoom into its screen or its keyboard.

ON IPHONE DUO, IT BECOMES THE COMPUTER

Os comandos aparecem na tela e você pode alternar entre controle e toque quando quiser.

Feche para ver um pormenor. Abra para descobrir o resto da história.

O Duopaper reúne uma seleção cuidada de arte digital para explorar com dois enquadramentos. A vista fechada concentra o olhar; a vista aberta revela toda a composição. Uma só imagem cria a surpresa, tanto num ecrã dobrável como num formato mais amplo.

Descubra seis estilos: minimalista, ilustração, banda desenhada, tridimensional, gráfico e pintura. De ambientes serenos a composições cheias de personalidade, encontre imagens em alta definição que façam sentido no seu ecrã.

Desloque o controlo de abertura para comparar as duas vistas. Experimente o relógio, ajuste o ponto de enquadramento e leia a história da imagem. Utilize a pesquisa e guarde as suas escolhas nos favoritos para as reencontrar, mesmo sem ligação à internet.

Toda a coleção está disponível sem anúncios, compras integradas nem conta. Guarde o JPEG inteiro em Fotografias ou partilhe-o através do menu do sistema. O relógio e os ajustes de enquadramento afetam apenas a pré-visualização; a composição exportada mantém-se completa.

Depois de guardar, defina manualmente o fundo em Fotografias; a pré-visualização é uma referência e o recorte ou a animação do sistema podem ser diferentes.

pt.description:
Digline é um jogo de perfuração relaxante e fácil de aprender, onde cada descida é uma pequena aposta entre progresso e risco, e a verdadeira recompensa está mais fundo no subsolo.

Comece cada partida na sua oficina, escolha sua configuração e desça com combustível limitado e um equipamento improvisado. Abra caminho através de camadas de terra em constante mudança, decida o que coletar e escolha o momento certo para voltar antes que tudo se esgote.

Cada descida revela novos materiais, descobertas mais raras e padrões inesperados sob a superfície. O que começa como uma simples escavação gradualmente se transforma em um equilíbrio cuidadoso entre exploração, eficiência e tempo.

De volta à superfície, refine sua estratégia e melhore suas partidas:

• Melhore sua perfuradora, capacidade de combustível e eficiência
• Desbloqueie novos materiais de maior valor e localizados mais profundamente
• Otimize rotas para maximizar cada descida

O progresso se acumula de forma constante, mas cada partida carrega tensão. Se jogar com muita cautela, você deixa valor para trás. Se avançar demais, corre o risco de perder tudo.

Defina seu próprio ritmo no subsolo: partidas curtas e eficientes, descidas profundas de alto risco ou uma progressão constante rumo ao domínio do que está abaixo.

Top 10 jogos casuais nos Estados Unidos e no Reino Unido, Top 5 na Alemanha, Noruega e outros. Venha se juntar à diversão!

O que começa como uma simples busca por recursos gradualmente se torna algo mais estranho. Seus antigos túneis permanecem, seu mapa se expande com o tempo, e o subsolo passa a parecer menos aleatório e mais como um lugar com sua própria história.

Digline foi projetado para ser fácil de começar, divertido em sessões curtas e recompensador no longo prazo. Escavações rápidas, descidas curtas, muita diversão relaxante.

Recursos:

• controles intuitivos com um dedo em modo retrato
• partidas curtas que cabem facilmente em um ou dois minutos
• túneis persistentes e um mapa que cresce a cada expedição
• múltiplas regiões subterrâneas com diferentes materiais, perigos e surpresas
• recursos para coletar e usar na criação de melhorias e melhor preparação
• uma oficina que transforma cada partida bem-sucedida em progresso permanente
• um sistema de mercado para negociar o que você traz de volta
• progressão que se constrói ao longo de muitas sessões, não apenas uma única partida
• uma atmosfera calma e aconchegante com um senso de descoberta por baixo
• sem anúncios, sem compras dentro do aplicativo e sem sistemas pay-to-win
• conquistas e competição no placar do Daily Dig

Quanto mais fundo você vai, mais a mina revela.
